## Tea Time with Women in Mathematics

I’m interested in supporting gender equality in mathematics. For this, I help organize the **[Tea Time with Women in Mathematics](https://www.mathematics.uni-bonn.de/hcm/diversity-equity/tea-time-with-women-in-mathematics)** at the University of Bonn. The events aim to connect and support FLINTA* individuals in Bonn.

## Student representation

I am involved in the mathematics student council and serve as a student representative for PhD students at the University of Bonn. Together, we organize events for PhD students: [PhD events at Bonn](https://www.fsmath.uni-bonn.de/de/veranstaltungen/phd)
